answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. An identity earns only when its zenith recurs, its plume survives audit, and a walnut from an unlinked peer confirms it.
